title: 29 August 1962: Live: Floral Hall Ballroom, Morecambe
content:
This was the first of two performances The Beatles gave at the Floral Hall Ballroom on the Promenade in Morecambe, Lancashire.

They returned to the venue on 18 January 1963.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024

  • 1998: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Salle Des Etoiles, Monte Carlo
  • 1989: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Cal Expo Amphitheatre, Sacramento
  • 1980: Recording: Every Man Has A Woman Who Loves Him, Woman, Dear Yoko by John Lennon and Yoko Ono
  • 1974: Filming, recording: One Hand Clapping by Wings
  • 1974: Mixing: Old Dirt Road by John Lennon
  • 1973: Mixing: I Know (I Know), Intuition by John Lennon
  • 1973: Denny Seiwell quits Wings
  • 1971: Recording: Toilet Piece/Unknown by Yoko Ono
  • 1968: Recording: Dear Prudence
  • 1966: The Beatles live: Candlestick Park, San Francisco: their final concert
  • 1965: The Beatles live: Hollywood Bowl, Los Angeles

  • 1960: The Beatles live: Indra Club, Hamburg
